description:
Returns the billing-cycle history of a subscription, including the payment attempts of each cycle.

Each billing cycle is one Ottu transaction with order number `<subscription ID>-c<cycle number>` (for example `sub_…-c2`). Every retry attempt belongs to that one transaction. The first payment is your own checkout transaction, so its `session_id` is the one you created.

`limit` and `offset` belong in the query string, and `next` and `previous` can be followed directly with `GET`. A cycle with `status: "needs_triage"` means you should contact Ottu support.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of billing cycles to return. Defaults to 20; maximum is 100.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the first billing cycle to return. Defaults to 0.

parameters.name: subscription_id
parameters.description: AutoPay subscription identifier returned by subscription creation.

count.description: The total number of billing cycles that match, across all pages, not only the ones in `results`.

next.description: URL of the next page, on your Ottu domain. Follow it with `GET`. `null` on the last page.

previous.description: URL of the previous page, on your Ottu domain. Follow it with `GET`. `null` on the first page.

cycle_number.description: The position of this billing period in the subscription, starting at 1. Cycles are returned in this order, oldest first.

scheduled_date.description: The date this period was, or is, due to be charged, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

amount_due.description: The amount charged or to be charged for this period, as a decimal string in the subscription's currency.

status.description: Where this cycle stands. One of `scheduled` (not attempted yet), `processing` (a charge is in flight), `paid`, `retry_scheduled` (an attempt failed and the next automatic retry is queued), `failed` (every retry was used up, and the subscription is now `past_due`), `canceled` (canceled together with the subscription), or `needs_triage` (contact Ottu support).

paid_at.description: UTC timestamp of when the cycle was collected. `null` until it is `paid`.

failure_reason.description: The gateway's message from the most recent failed attempt. `null` if no attempt has failed.

session_id.description: The Ottu `session_id` of the latest charge attempt for this cycle. `null` while the cycle is `scheduled` and has not been attempted.

charge_type.description: How the cycle was charged. `cit` is a customer-initiated payment: the first payment at checkout, or a recovery payment. `mit` is an automatic charge Ottu makes against the saved card, and it is already set on a scheduled cycle that has not been attempted. To tell whether a cycle was attempted, check `status` and `payment_attempts`, not `charge_type`.

attempt_number.description: The position of this attempt within its cycle, starting at 1. It increases by one on each retry.

session_id.description: The Ottu `session_id` of the payment transaction created for this attempt.

result.description: The outcome of the attempt. `success` means the charge was collected. `failed` means it was declined or the gateway returned an error. `pending` means the charge was started and its outcome is not confirmed yet, which normally resolves within minutes. `null` before any outcome is recorded.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp of when Ottu started this attempt, in ISO 8601 format.

items.description: A single attempt to collect a billing cycle.

payment_attempts.description: Every charge attempt made for this cycle, oldest first. More than one entry means the cycle was retried after a failure. See [Retries & Dunning](/developers/payments/autopay/#retries-and-dunning).

items.description: One billing period of a subscription and every attempt made to collect it. A cycle that needed retries carries more than one entry in `payment_attempts`.

results.description: The billing cycles on this page, oldest first. An empty array when nothing matches.

schema.description: One page of a subscription's billing cycles. `limit` and `offset` belong in the query string, and `next` and `previous` can be followed directly with `GET`.

responses.description: The API key is missing or invalid. Send your private API key as `Authorization: Api-Key <your key>`.
No subscription with this id exists on your account. Do not retry.
Payments are paused on your Ottu account (`code: service_paused`), so the subscription endpoints are unavailable. Retry once payments are resumed.
The subscription service is unavailable. Retry with backoff.
The subscription service timed out. Nothing was changed, so the request is safe to retry.
